author: reek
body: The generation engine. A prompt arrives as ridiculously vague text. The engine extracts every invariant the prompt actually pins down (vertical, platform, language, revenue target, and the two famous constraints: ask no questions, make no mistakes), then fills every free dimension deterministically from the request serial and a hash of the prompt, so the same prompt yields a fresh idea on every request. The response is composed as a JsonValue tree and emitted by the Json foreword; no JSON is assembled by string concatenation.

author: reek
body: Percent-decoding for query parameters. A plus sign is a space, a percent sign followed by two hex digits is that byte, and anything malformed passes through undecoded rather than failing.

author: reek
body: The invariants a prompt pins down. A vertical constraint of zero means unconstrained; six means any gambling vertical. Platform and language are empty text when the prompt leaves them free.

author: reek
body: A small modular hash keyed on the prompt, combined with the request serial under distinct prime strides per dimension, so successive requests walk different orbits through each list. No two dimensions share a stride and every list length is coprime to none of them, which is fine: the point is variety, not cryptography.

author: reek
body: The offer protocol needs candidates drawn only from unreserved seeds. eligible-indexes filters the database down to indexes that match the vertical constraint and are not on the reserved list; pick-3 selects three distinct indexes from that pool, spread by a stride so consecutive offers do not cluster in one vertical run.

author: reek
body: Small parsers the routes and the server shell share: integer query values, a header scan for the proxy-supplied client address, and the holder mask shown on the public claims board.
